title: Compostelle, le Chemin des Étoiles
overview: What if we all had a good reason to set out on the Camino de Santiago? Laurent leaves from Le Puy-en-Velay for a five-month journey — 1,700 kilometres on foot, all the way to Santiago de Compostela. A legendary trail, a spiritual quest that speaks to something universal, a chance to meet others and discover yourself along the way. Explore these breathtaking landscapes from the air and experience the magic of a path unlike any other, one that wears many faces — several of its stretches and monuments recognised as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
